logcat.ai is an AI-native platform for autonomous Android and Linux device systems engineering, from smartphones to vehicles, robots, network and telecom equipment, and embedded hardware
Founded in 2025 and based in Seattle and Bengaluru
Diagnose: autonomous investigation across the device stack. Upload a bugreport, logcat, dmesg, modem trace, CAN bus capture, or a bundle of them. Get a cited root-cause report back, in minutes.

Remediate: AI-proposed fixes, human-approved. Diagnose finds the root cause. Remediate proposes the patch: cross-layer, cited back to the investigation that produced it, gated by the engineer who has to merge it. AI never commits; the human always does.
